senses.gloss: (I)--a राक्षस and a son of खशा. As he wanted to eat his own mother, he got the name of यक्ष; of four hands and four feet, a fearful figure wandering in the night in search of prey; took the form of Vasuruci and lived with the apsaras क्रथुस्थला in Nandana; she bore him a son रजतनाभ; went home in the हिमालयस् with the son, when क्रथुस्थला came to know of his birth as a राक्षस. Br. III. 7. ६०, १००-17; २२. १४; ४१. ३०; ७१. १११; वा. ६९. १६०, १६७.
--chiefly four, Loheyas, Bharateyas, कृशाङ्- geyas, and विशालेयस् after the four daughters of सुयशा (स्।व्।). वा. ६९. १५-6.
--the tribe born to Kapila, the यक्ष and केशिनी--inferior to Gandharvas by three steps. Br. III. 7. १४६-167; IV. 4. 2; वा. ६९. १७८.

--a शक्ति;
1: Br. IV. २०. १५.
an image of; surrounded by the Devas, दानवस् and the नागस्; hoods and two tongues to be carved above the head; also the spirits of the air and the evil spirits encircle her.
2: M. २६१. ४७-50.
--one of the ten पीठस् for images with three मेखलस्; this gives one plenty of cows. M. २६२. 6, 8, १७.

--is Kubera (स्।व्।);
1: Br. IV. २०. ५०.
a follower of शिव in battle; helped वामदेव S4iva in his war with Soma.
2: M. २३. ३८.
--Phthisis which afflicted Soma as a result of दक्ष's curse. भा. VI. 6. २३. [page३-003+ ३७]
